APEX VECTOR Site Brief Drop a pin, get the site survey and risk sheet pre-filled

Both PDFs stay fillable. Hazard rows are only marked Present when a map shows one; Clear is never pre-ticked. Live TFRs and NOTAMs are not checked here: check tfr.faa.gov and your LAANC app on the day.

Use my own blank sheets

The page has built-in copies of SOP-SITE-005 and SOP-RISK-001 Rev 2.0. To use your own copies of these forms, load them here; the field names need to match.
